title: 3DOF Angular Acceleration
text: 实现相对于机体轴的三自由度运动方程，输入 4 路、输出 7 路；按 {Mass type} 指定质量类型；{Units}、{Axes}、{Initial velocity}、{Initial body attitude}、{Initial body rotation rate}、{Initial incidence}、{Initial position (x,z)}、{Initial mass}、{Inertia}、{Gravity Source}、{Acceleration due to gravity}、{Include inertial acceleration}、{Velocity: e.g., ’u, ’w’}、{Position: e.g., ’Xe’, ’Ze’}、{Pitch angular rate e.g., ’q’}、{Pitch attitude: e.g., ’theta’} 同样影响行为。

ports.name: F x
ports.summary: 沿 x 轴施加的力 scalar

ports.name: F z
ports.summary: 沿 z 轴施加的力 scalar

params.name: Units
params.values: 输入和输出单位 Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Axes
params.values: 机体轴或风轴 Body (default) | Wind

params.name: Mass type
params.values: 质量类型 Fixed (default) | Simple Variable | Custom Variable

params.name: Initial body rotation rate
params.values: 初始俯仰旋转速率 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Include inertial acceleration
params.values: 包括惯性加速度端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Velocity: e.g., {’u, ’w’}
params.values: 速度状态名称 ’’ (default) | comma-separated list surrounded by braces

params.name: Position: e.g., {’Xe’, ’Ze’}
params.values: 位置状态名称 ’’ (default) | comma-separated list surrounded by braces
